class.name: IfcBSplineCurveWithKnots
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO 10303:42:1994 : This is the type of b-spline curve for which the knot values are explicitly given. This subtype shall be used to represent non-uniform B-spline curves and may be used for other knot types. Let L denote the number of distinct values amongst the d + k +2 knots in the knot list; L will be referred to as the ‘upper index on knots’. Let m j denote the multiplicity (i
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: The multiplicities of the knots. This list defines the number of times each knot in the knots list is to be repeated in constructing the knot array. A PackedInt64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The list of distinct knots used to define the B-spline basis functions. A PackedFloat64Array, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

The description of the knot type. This is for information only. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
